title: Watchface, widget and notifications take time to update
body:
Good evening. Whenever AAPS receives xDrip's data it updates, but widget, watchface and notification (the one you see when you wipe from the top of the screen) takes some time (sometimes 1-3 minutes, and the watchface even 15-20 minutes in the worst of the cases, what makes it useless). That makes me receive an alarm from xDrip and see a different value in the watch. To avoid it I changed the watchface to xDrip, that updates inmediatly, but then I can't use treatments from the watch. I can't say if that happened in previous versions as I changed recently my watch, but in 2.8.2.1 it worked fine.
Both phone and watch are in version 3.1.0.3.
Thank you for your help.

comments.body:
That's what I said, any help? As soon as notification updates watchface and widget do too. AAPS in the phone shows the updated value, 120 in this case.
Thank you

That sounds sort of similar to what I was experiencing. Might be worth checking how much user data the app has stored?
